parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the switch buttons of the wall switch assembly, made of durable ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator for turning electrical circuits on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by a small rotational or pressing motion to toggle between on and off positions.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch button of the wall switch assembly, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, allowing independent operation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves similarly to the other switches, toggling between on and off states.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the third switch button of the wall switch assembly, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides control for an additional circuit or device.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pressing or flipping to change the electrical connection state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or housing of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate for strength and insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switches in place and provides electrical insulation and structural support.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
